
RunAsh AI - LLM Integration Notes

- Primary app: Next.js (App Router) repository for RunAsh AI.
- Main integration surfaces:
  - API routes under app/api
  - Service logic under services and lib/services
  - Agentic features under lib/agentic-protocol.ts and related UI/components
- Before introducing new model providers or prompts:
  - document configuration in README and relevant guide
  - avoid hardcoding provider secrets
  - keep model-specific behavior behind service abstractions

RunAsh AI - LLM Contributor Brief

Project:
- Agentic live commerce platform with streaming, AI video tooling, seller operations, and payment/auth business flows.

Stack:
- Next.js + React + TypeScript
- Node.js runtime

Key directories:
- app/: route-driven UI surfaces
- components/: reusable UI and domain components
- services/: business/service integrations and processing logic
- contexts/: app-level state providers
- docs (*.md): product/architecture/security/process references

Safety boundaries:
- Never expose secrets in code or docs.
- Avoid breaking API contracts in service/payment/auth flows.
- Keep diffs small and scoped to user request.

Required checks before handoff:
- npm run lint
- npm run build (when environment supports dependency graph)

Documentation sync:
- Update AGENTS.md / AGENTS.override.md / TEAM_GUIDE.md for process changes.
- Update payment/auth docs when changing those flows.

Contribution style:
- Prefer minimal, reversible changes.
- Include validation commands and clear summary.
